topic_title: Winter Driving Hazards, Bridges & Black Ice
prompt: Why do elevated highway bridges and overpasses in Texas freeze before adjacent roadway ground surfaces?

options.text: Cold ambient air circulates above and beneath bridge decks, cooling them faster
Bridges are constructed from reflective steel metals that attract frost flakes
Underground geothermal heat warms standard highway pavement from below
Elevated bridges are positioned closer to cloud formations and ice crystals
